svg.title: XeLaTeX compilation: up to 6.9 times faster
svg.desc: Original versus Texgo PDF compilation, median of five two-pass runs. 12 plots: 2.659 to 0.589 seconds; 12 raster images: 2.749 to 0.700; 24 mixed images: 4.858 to 0.701. Conversion cost excluded; see benchmark methodology.
